_comment: Copy this file to backup.config.json and fill in your tenant values. backup.config.json is gitignored and must never be committed.

exchange._comment: Per-mailbox export tweaks. skipMailboxIRMAccess silences Get-MailboxIRMAccess (requires AIP/Purview Information Protection to be activated). skipSystemMailboxes filters out DiscoverySearchMailbox, HealthMailbox, SystemMailbox{...}, FederatedEmail.* and Migration.* arbitration boxes.

extendedExports._comment: Per-object exports iterate every mailbox/team/site/group. They are accurate but slow on large tenants. Set the relevant flag to false to skip.

defender._comment: Defender for Endpoint uses api.securitycenter.microsoft.com — the same app must have WindowsDefenderATP API permissions granted. Set enabled: false to skip.

powerPlatform._comment: Power Platform module does not support certificate auth, so you need a client secret on the same app registration. If you do not want to add one, leave enabled: false

prechecks._comment: Run Test-M365BackupPrerequisites before the backup. Pass -SkipPrechecks on the command line to skip per-run. Set installMissingModules:true to auto-install required/optional PowerShell modules from PSGallery (equivalent to passing -InstallMissingModules).

precheck._comment: Optional extra Graph application roles to require during precheck. Added on top of the built-in per-workload list. Useful for tenants that need permissions outside the standard set.
